purpose: Parallel baseline validation for KIRA OS architecture workstreams. This does not claim the architecture blocks are implemented.

parallel_lanes.acceptance: KIRA-owned BIOS and UEFI paths populate validated BootInfo; BIOS and OVMF tests pass; release ISO contains no GRUB binaries/modules.
KCC builds KCC and required system translation units for x86_64 and AArch64 with deterministic output and documented ABI/object/link strategy.
Implementation is independently derived from public hardware specifications, preserves required PCI/RX/TX/error handling, has provenance review, fault injection and QEMU integration tests.
Signed manifest validation fails closed; key rotation/revocation and persistent highest-version enforcement are tested, including interrupted updates and recovery.
Per-device domains implement map/unmap, invalidation, DMA masks and fault reporting; negative tests prove out-of-domain DMA is blocked.
Per-device SMMU domains and cache/bounce-buffer policy are tested under QEMU/model tests; physical-board evidence remains separately required.
ACPI routing behavior is complete or explicitly reports unsupported routes; long-run GUI/Mind suites and release image provenance checks have retained evidence.

execution_policy.retry: Only after collecting lane logs, classifying failures, and committing a correction. Never retry unchanged failures blindly.
execution_policy.release_rule: No ISO or update archive is declared final until all mandatory architecture acceptance criteria and the existing release gate pass.
